overview: Students interested in studying mechanical engineering, manufacturing, automotive technology, industrial design and energy systems often choose Italy as a place to study. In Italian universities, engineering students are taught in classrooms but also get plenty of practical experience in labs and in technical projects.

In Italy Bachelors in Mechanical Engineering is a 3-year undergraduate degree, called Laurea, with 180 ECTS credits. The course covers mathematics, physics, mechanics, thermodynamics, materials science, machine design and manufacturing processes.

To Study Mechanical Engineering Bachelors in Italy is a good opportunity for Indian students who have completed their Class 12 to experience European education and build a strong foundation for a technical career or further studies.
But students should check the language of instruction, entrance examinations, eligibility criteria and application deadlines before selecting a university.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide helps students shortlist appropriate universities, understand admission requirements, compare tuition fees and prepare the documents required for studying in Italy.

sections.title: Why Study Bachelors in Mechanical Engineering Italy?

items: The Italian industrial base is strong in the areas of automotive manufacturing, industrial machinery, automation, engineering design and advanced technology.

In the Italian universities students are taught the basic concepts of engineering and their application to the design of machines, the development of mechanical components and the improvement of production systems.
Why Study Mechanical Engineering in Italy? Here are some reasons:
Strong Engineering Foundation: Students gain knowledge in important subjects such as mathematics, physics, mechanics, thermodynamics, and materials science.
Practical Learning: Students might work on laboratory assignments, engineering projects, design tasks and practical training, depending on the university.
Industrial Applications: Students learn how mechanical engineering is applied in the fields of manufacturing, machine design, automotive technology and industrial production.
International Education: Students are offered the chance to study in a European university setting and experience different cultures.
Further Study Opportunities: The bachelor's degree graduates can apply for relevant master's programs based on their academic achievements.
Scholarships and Financial Aid: Students who qualify can explore the option of scholarships, regional benefits and tuition fee waivers offered by universities and other institutions.

Students choosing Mechanical Engineering Bachelors in Italy must look at the course curriculum, language of instruction, entrance examinations, total expense and practical learning opportunities before picking a university.

sections.title: Courses in Mechanical Engineering in Italy

items: Mechanical engineering bachelor's programs provide learners with an understanding of how machines and mechanical systems are designed, developed, operated and improved.
In the course, students learn the scientific principles and technical skills needed for a variety of engineering applications.
The Core Subjects
Depending on the university, students can study:
Engineering Mathematics
Mechanics and Physics
Computer Aided Design and Engineering Drawing
Science of materials
Thermo-dynamics
Fluid Mechanics
Technology of Manufacture
Design of Machine
Measurements on Mechanical Equipment
Production Systems
Systems of Energy
Fundamental Control Systems
These subjects teach students how mechanical systems work and how engineering principles are applied in industries.
Areas of Expertise
Students can choose different streams of mechanical engineering through elective subjects, projects or further studies.
Automotive Engineering: Students study vehicle design, engines, vehicle performance and automotive manufacturing.
Manufacturing Engineering: This is an engineering discipline that deals with production methods, manufacturing processes, quality management and industrial systems.
Robotics and Automation: Students study robotics, mechanical systems, sensors and automation technologies used in industry.
Energy Engineering: The field of energy engineering deals with energy conversion, thermal systems, energy efficiency and sustainable technologies.
Aerospace Engineering: Students may choose relevant engineering programs or further studies to learn about aircraft structures and propulsion and aerospace systems.
Materials Engineering: This field is concerned with the material properties, manufacturing methods and development of materials utilized in engineering.

Students interested in Mechanical Engineering Courses in Italy should check that the specialization they wish to study is available as a bachelor's degree or if they will need to take a separate master's course.

What Do Entrance Exams Test?
Entrance examinations may test, depending on university:
Mathematics

Other topics included in the official examination syllabus
Students need to follow the official test syllabus and admission rules for their preparation.

Can Indian Students apply Post Class 12?
Yes, Indian students can apply after Class 12 if their school qualification meets the entry requirements of the university.
They must also satisfy the subject requirements, language requirements, entrance examination regulations and documentation requirements.
Admission is not based on just passing Class 12.

sections.title: Career Opportunities After Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering in Italy

items: After graduation in mechanical engineering, students can pursue manufacturing, automotive technology, industrial machinery, energy, automation, product design and engineering services.
Career paths are determined by the qualifications of students, their technical skills, practical experience and employer requirements.
Career Pathways
Junior Mechanical Engineer: assists with engineering, mechanical systems and technical projects.
Mechanical Design Assistant: Assists in developing and designing mechanical parts.
CAD Design Engineer: Uses computer-aided design software to create engineering drawings and models.
Manufacturing Engineer Trainee: Learns manufacturing processes, production methods and industrial systems.
Production Engineer Trainee: Assist in production planning, manufacturing operations and process improvement.
Quality Control Engineer: Assists in the checking of products, materials and manufacturing processes to ensure quality standards are met.
Maintenance Engineering Assistant: Provides assistance with the maintenance and operation of mechanical equipment.
Automotive Engineering Trainee: Assists with automotive systems, vehicle components and engineering activities .
Energy Systems Assistant: Helping with energy systems, thermal equipment and energy efficiency tasks.
Industrial Engineering Assistant: Assists in improving production systems, industrial processes and operational efficiency.
Testing and Validation Assistant: Provides support for testing and performance evaluation of mechanical parts and systems.
Technical Project Assistant: Support engineering projects, technical documentation and project coordination.
Students can improve their career prospects by gaining practical engineering skills , relevant software and experience through projects or internships .

faq.question: Can Indian students do mechanical engineering in Italy after 12th?
faq.answer: Yes, Indian students can apply after Class 12, as long as their school qualification is equivalent to the university's entry requirements. They must also satisfy the academic, language, entrance examination and document requirements of the program they have chosen.

faq.question: Are mechanical engineering bachelor's degrees taught in English in Italy?
faq.answer: Many Italian undergraduate programs in mechanical engineering are taught in Italian. Some universities may have different language requirements. Students are advised to check the teaching language and the language requirement of the program they are applying for.

faq.question: What are the fees for mechanical engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: As a general planning estimate, public university tuition may range from approximately €900 to €4,000 per year. Private schools may charge more for tuition. Actual tuition will depend on the University, the program and the applicable fee rules.

faq.question: Do I need to pass an entrance exam to study mechanical engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: Many universities require an entrance examination or selection process. For example, the University of Bologna requires TOLC-I for its 2026/27 bachelor's degree programs in mechanical engineering. Requirements for university entrance exams differ.

faq.question: What jobs can I get after completing a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering in Italy?
faq.answer: Graduates will be able to work in mechanical design, manufacturing, automotive technology, quality control, maintenance, energy systems and industrial production.
